payload.summary: Jim's shower-thought vision (chat, 2026-07-25), deliberately loose — pick up after Phase 2 lands: software development has 5 critical parts and nahel currently covers only #2 deeply. (1) Product roadmaps -> feature roadmaps; (2) Development (PRD -> Epic -> Issue — nahel's strength, inherited from ccpm); (3) QA (roadmap Phase 3); (4) Deployment; (5) Marketing/communications. The nebulous 'I want to start with a one-liner' feeling all session was really about #1: WHAT FEEDS the development process. Hands-off founding (Phase 2 F9) is the degenerate case — a paragraph is a nano-roadmap. Direction: once nahel's core development loop works end-to-end, pivot to roadmap creation + management as the layer above plan items (product roadmap -> feature roadmaps -> PRDs). Note: docs/roadmap.md is itself a hand-written instance of what this would systematize — prime dogfood. NOT fleshed out by design; grill session required before any PRD.
